about: The robot's sensors and actuators as Embody Mode exposes them (StackChan firmware, branch embody-mj41). where: a robot3d part and an offset in millimetres in robot3d's rest space (Y up, facing +Z; the part's node in robot.glb); how: exact (it is there), joint (the joint it moves), inside (somewhere in that part), near (the docs say roughly where). No where: the docs do not say where it is.

parts.name: Touch screen
parts.does: Two fingers on the screen: taps with x/y, double tap, long press, touch_down/touch_up per finger, and a 50 Hz raw stream of both fingers while a browser asks.

sources.quote: | Touch | the board's FT6336 driver reads both points

where.note: the screen's centre on the CoreS3's front

parts.name: Camera
parts.does: Live JPEG video at 320x240 (5 fps) or 640x480 (about 2.3 fps), 640x480 snapshots, mirror/flip, raw sensor registers; refused while the camera and microphone are off on the robot.

sources.quote: **Camera and microphone, set on the robot:**

parts.name: Microphones
parts.does: Two channels at 24 kHz sent raw: channel 1 the microphone, channel 0 the speaker reference (for echo cancellation).

sources.quote: | Microphone | a FreeRTOS task reads all codec input channels at 24 kHz

parts.name: Accelerometer and gyroscope
parts.does: Acceleration per axis (g) and rotation rate (°/s) in telemetry, the shake event, and a raw 100 Hz stream while a browser asks; it sits in the CoreS3, so it tilts with the head.

where.note: the IMU sits in the CoreS3 (HARDWARE.md line 21): somewhere in the CoreS3 (marked at its centre)

parts.name: Magnetometer (compass)
parts.does: The magnetic field per axis (µT, compensated, and raw counts) at 10 Hz; a compass needs calibration (the speaker's and servos' magnets).

sources.quote: | Magnetometer (compass) | BMM150 (0x10) on the BMI270's AUX I2C

parts.name: Ambient light
parts.does: The room's light in lux; auto-brightness sets the backlight from it (on by default).

where.note: the LTR-553ALS is in the CoreS3 (README.md line 139): somewhere in the CoreS3 (marked at its centre)

parts.name: Proximity
parts.does: Something near: proximity counts (0–2047), proximity_near/proximity_far events; an approach wakes the screen. Its IR LED next to the camera pulses about 10 times a second.

where.note: the LTR-553ALS is in the CoreS3 (README.md line 139): somewhere in the CoreS3 (marked at its centre)

parts.name: Head touch panel
parts.does: Three zones on the head: head_press with each zone's intensity (0–3), head_release with its duration, swipe forward/back; any of them wakes the screen.

parts.name: Servo feedback
parts.does: Per servo: angle, load (%), temperature, supply voltage, raw position, speed and current, moving.

where.note: the two head servos; marked at the yaw joint (the pitch servo is at the pitch joint)

parts.name: IR receiver
parts.does: Infrared remote codes: ir_received with the raw timings, NEC decoded.

sources.quote: | IR receiver | IRM56384 on the Touch board

parts.name: NFC reader
parts.does: NFC tags held to the robot: nfc_tag with UID, type and the first NDEF record (URI or text) of Type 2 tags, nfc_removed; polled twice a second.

sources.quote: | NFC reader | ST25R3916 (0x50), IRQ not wired

parts.name: Battery (PMU)
parts.does: Battery %, charging, battery/USB/system voltage, charge state and phase, die temperature; USB and battery plugged/removed events.

parts.name: Battery monitor (body)
parts.does: The body battery's voltage, current (+ drain, − charging), power and raw shunt voltage.

parts.name: USB ports
parts.does: A computer or a charger plugged in (usb_data, core_vbus_v, plug events); which of the two ports (head or stand) cannot be told.

where.note: the CoreS3's USB-C on its right side (the stand's port is not modelled)

parts.name: Power button
parts.does: power_button with a short or long press; a short press wakes the screen; held about 4 s it powers off.

sources.quote: | Power button | on the AXP2101 PWRON

parts.name: Real-time clock
parts.does: The time (rtc_unix in telemetry).

parts.name: Chip temperature, Wi-Fi
parts.does: Wi-Fi RSSI, free memory, chip temperature.

parts.name: Display
parts.does: The 2.0" 320x240 screen: face, emotions, speech, stickers, pictures, QR codes, blank screen, brightness.

where.note: the screen's centre on the CoreS3's front

parts.name: Head yaw servo
parts.does: Turns the head left and right: angle ±128°, nod/shake/home, continuous rotation for 1–30 s after a Yes on the robot; slack at rest, hold keeps it powered.

sources.quote: The yaw axis is the Y axis

where.note: the yaw joint: the servo body turns on the plate about the yaw axis

parts.name: Head pitch servo
parts.does: Tilts the head up and down: angle 5–85° (M5Stack's safe range), nod; slack at rest.

where.note: the pitch joint: robot3d's pitch pivot, the servo's horn

source.quote: pivot is the pitch axis (along X) at rest: the servo's horn

parts.name: RGB LEDs, left
parts.does: Six of the 12 RGB LEDs (0–5, 0 at the front) under the left light bar: a colour per side or per LED, and effects (rainbow, breathe, chase, blink).

sources.quote: | RGB LEDs, 12 | WS2812C x12, two rows
`pixels` sets up to 12 single LEDs (left 0–5, then right 6–11

where.note: the left light bar (+X), along the top

source.quote: left, +X, LED 0 at the front; on the right LED 11

parts.name: RGB LEDs, right
parts.does: Six of the 12 RGB LEDs (6–11) under the right light bar: a colour per side or per LED, and effects (rainbow, breathe, chase, blink).

sources.quote: | RGB LEDs, 12 | WS2812C x12, two rows
`pixels` sets up to 12 single LEDs (left 0–5, then right 6–11

where.note: the right light bar (-X), along the top

source.quote: left, +X, LED 0 at the front; on the right LED 11

parts.name: Speaker
parts.does: Sound: talk from a browser, sound files, beeps (24 kHz PCM), volume; the mouth moves while it plays.

parts.name: IR transmitter
parts.does: Sends infrared remote codes (NEC or raw timings, repeat, frames); weak, so short range. It points up.

sources.quote: | IR transmitter | IR LED on top of the robot near the display unit

where.note: on top of the robot near the display unit (HARDWARE.md line 44): marked on the CoreS3's top; the exact place is not in the docs

parts.name: Power/charge LED
parts.does: The red power LED: on, off, blink, fast, or driven by the charger.

sources.quote: | Power/charge LED (red) | on the AXP2101 (CHGLED, reg 0x69)

parts.name: Servo power
parts.does: Switches the servos' supply: both head servos powered or limp.
